Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the DTM–ITC relationship and prematurely shifted the target series to ITC, asserting that DTM “continued” as ITC. This incorrect timeline assumption (later compounded by mentioning a non-existent “1997 first combined DTM/ITC season”) led the process down the wrong path and caused repetitive, unproductive searches instead of verifying authoritative sources and correctly identifying the series after the AMG/HWA contract.
